name: decoding
description: Deterministic convergence engine for derived legacy-system archaeology claims

arguments.name: claims
arguments.description: Derived claim.v0 JSONL inputs for archaeology

options.name: json
options.description: JSON status on stderr; archaeology stdout remains canon_entry.v0 JSONL

options.name: explicit
options.description: Emit raw candidate claim values; default preserves each fixed kind and redacts only scalar value or reference id with deterministic ordinal refs or keyed HMAC markers

options.name: describe
options.description: Emit this embedded manifest verbatim without inputs

options.name: schema
options.description: Emit JSON Schema for each canonical stdout record without inputs

commands.name: archaeology
commands.description: Converge derived claim.v0 records; directly observed catalog metadata bypasses decoding

options.name: explicit
options.description: Emit raw candidate claim values; default preserves each fixed kind and redacts only scalar value or reference id with deterministic ordinal refs or keyed HMAC markers

1.meaning: One or more buckets escalated for human review

2.meaning: Invalid input, policy, usage, or operational failure

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Emit this operator.v1 contract as JSON; doctor capabilities --json is retained as a deprecated alias

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only health diagnostics; doctor capabilities and doctor robot-docs are retained aliases; --robot-triage is a deprecated alias for doctor triage --json

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Bounded operating guide; doctor robot-docs [guide] is retained as a deprecated alias

0.meaning: All buckets resolved, or discovery completed

1.meaning: Converged with escalations requiring human review

2.meaning: Refusal, usage error, or operational error; never an escalation

refusals.message: Malformed JSONL, unknown fields or vocabulary, invalid claim_id, context, ancestry or value shape
Invalid policy JSON, unknown policy keys, invalid numeric bounds or policy values
DECODING_REDACTION_KEY is not valid UTF-8 or is shorter than 16 bytes
Cannot read an input or write an explicit output; operational error rather than domain refusal

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Disables ANSI styling; decoding emits plain text when piped regardless

env_vars.name: TERM
env_vars.description: Terminal declaration; TERM=dumb is always ANSI-free

env_vars.name: DECODING_REDACTION_KEY
env_vars.description: Optional operator-held HMAC-SHA256 key for redacted escalation markers; must be at least 16 bytes and is never emitted

env_vars.name: DECODING_DOCTOR_FORCE_UNHEALTHY
env_vars.description: Test-only health fixture that makes doctor report an error finding

side_effects.notes: Archaeology reads explicit claim and policy files and writes only explicit output paths; discovery commands are read-only.
